value.rationale: The completely bounded norm is the canonical quantitative distortion between operator-space structures. Replacing an abstract supremum over all matrix levels by one explicit separable spectral witness is a structural attainment theorem, not a renaming or fixed-parameter computation. It also shows that the ordinary and minimal Shalit–Shamovich radii have identical power to measure this distortion on a carefully constructed tuple.
